title: Bien Hoa, Dong Nai — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bien Hoa, Dong Nai: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bien Hoa is a city in Dong Nai with a population of 1,100,000. An industrial hub adjacent to Ho Chi Minh City, offering significantly lower housing costs while providing access to the economic opportunities of the greater metro area. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
